summary.text: Patrick Testin is a Republican member of the Wisconsin Senate representing District 24, based in Stevens Point, and has been elected to the Senate since 2016.
He chairs the Committee on Agriculture and Revenue and has held the President Pro Tempore position.

paragraphs.text: Testin was born in Madison, Wisconsin, on June 9, 1988, and is married.

He graduated from Marinette High School in 2006, earned a B.S. in political science from the University of Wisconsin-Stevens Point in 2011, and was a Bowhay Institute for Legislative Leadership Development fellow in 2018.
The Legislature's page lists him as a sales professional for a Wisconsin-based wine distributor.
It says he held the Majority Caucus Vice Chair leadership position in 2017 and 2019 and was President Pro Tempore in 2021 and 2023.
He is vice-chair of the Committee on Finance and the Committee on Health and a member of the Stevens Point Elk Lodge 641 and the Civil Air Patrol Wisconsin Wing Legislative Squadron.
